# gian.ink - Developer Portal & Web Applications

> Personal developer portal, portfolio, and central gateway to self-hosted cloud applications operated by Gian in Switzerland.

## Author & Operator
- Name: Gian
- Country: Switzerland (Schweiz)
- Contact: gian@gaudi.ch
- GitHub: https://github.com/GianUwU
- Single Sign-On: https://auth.gian.ink (Powered by Authentik)

## Web Applications in the Network
- [Main Portal](https://gian.ink): Personal project showcase, portfolio, and directory.
- [Finance Tracker](https://finance.gian.ink): Expense analytics, budget management, monthly breakdown charts, and secure multi-user transaction logging.
- [Drop Cloud Storage](https://drop.gian.ink): Self-hosted, high-performance file sharing platform. Features drag-and-drop uploads, instant browser previews (PDF, audio, video, images, documents), clipboard pasting, personal drop links, and completely unthrottled streaming transfers with zero download/upload speed limits.
- [MTG Tabletop Sync](https://mtg.gian.ink): Real-time synchronized tabletop tracker for Magic: The Gathering matches.
- [Guess Who](https://guesswho.gian.ink): AI-powered pop-culture character guessing game featuring 2-player deep-lore similarity analysis and solo 20-questions mode.
- [Authentik SSO](https://auth.gian.ink): Centralized authentication and identity provider.

## Architecture
- Frontends: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, SPA routing
- Backend: Node.js (Express), SQLite3 databases, JWT session management
- Reverse Proxy: Traefik v3, Nginx, Let's Encrypt TLS/SSL
